title: The Pilgrim's Bell of Shalgora
summary: Rescue the abbey caravans of Stormhaven from a syndicate of turnpike highwaymen and Sanguine revel-cultists operating out of Farangel's Delve and Bonesnap Ruins.

npcs.name: Abbot Clement of Shalgora
npcs.greet: Grace of the Eight upon you, wayfarer. Have a care on the abbey turnpike—three pilgrim companies vanished between here and Urvaius.
talk: Our abbey stewards maintain the bridges and hospice-inns across Stormhaven, yet someone is drugging the wayside wine-casks with crimson lotus.
Pilgrims wake in chains inside Farangel's Delve with their offerings stripped. Speak with Provost-Marshal Thibault at Firebrand Keep.

npcs.name: Provost-Marshal Thibault
npcs.greet: The turnpike barons collect the road-toll and leave my lancers to patrol fifty leagues of forest with half a garrison!
talk: A former toll-warden named Reynard the Red-Cup has joined Sanguine's revel-cultists and woodland highwaymen.
They lure pilgrims from Urvaius into Farangel's Delve, then sell the ransom-notes through Bonesnap Ruins. Question Innkeeper Margot in Urvaius.

npcs.name: Margot of the Pilgrim's Rest
npcs.greet: Don't touch the spiced claret in the cellar! A carter wearing Firebrand livery delivered it at dusk, and it smells of sleeping-poppy.
talk: I followed the carter's lantern-marks to Farangel's Delve, where Toll-Master Gaspard guards the drugged pilgrims.
Free the pilgrims in Farangel's Delve, and they'll tell you where Reynard the Red-Cup keeps the abbey's reliquary!

npcs.name: Castellan Evrard
npcs.greet: Well struck at Farangel's Delve! Half the freed pilgrims have already reached the shelter of Wind Keep.
talk: Reynard the Red-Cup has fortified Bonesnap Ruins with his highwaymen and woodland warlocks.
Take the abbey banner into Bonesnap Ruins and reclaim the Reliquary of Mara!

story_sh_urvaius_cellar: Margot of the Pilgrim's Rest: Look at the bung-seal on this wine cask—stamped with the abbey's lily, but the wax is laced with red rose-thorn!
Provost-Marshal Thibault: Reynard's highwaymen are intercepting the hospice wagons at Glenmoor Memorial and swapping the casks.
Margot of the Pilgrim's Rest: Hurry to Farangel's Delve before they ship the sleeping pilgrims downriver!
story_sh_farangel_cells: Toll-Master Gaspard: Every pilgrim on the Stormhaven road pays twice—once at the turnpike gate, and once in our cells!
Provost-Marshal Thibault: Drop the cage keys, Gaspard, or we'll hang you from your own toll-beam!
story_sh_bonesnap_revel: Reynard the Red-Cup: Why should the abbeys hoard gold in cold stone reliquaries when one drop of lotus-wine turns a miser into a prince?
Castellan Evrard: You poisoned honest wayfarers and sold your oath for a gilded cup, Reynard!
Reynard the Red-Cup: Then drink deep of cold steel!

quests.title: The Drugged Hospice Wine
quests.summary: Report the missing pilgrim caravans to Provost-Marshal Thibault at Firebrand Keep and inspect the drugged wine in Urvaius.
intro: Pilgrim companies traveling the abbey turnpike from Shalgora have vanished after drinking at wayside hospices.
Speak with Provost-Marshal Thibault at Firebrand Keep, then inspect the cellar casks with Margot in Urvaius.
complete: The casks in Urvaius were laced with sleeping-lotus by highwaymen operating out of Farangel's Delve.

journal.start: Abbot Clement in Shalgora sent me to Firebrand Keep and Urvaius to investigate the vanishing pilgrims.
journal.done: We discovered lotus-drugged wine casks in Urvaius pointing to Farangel's Delve.

quests.title: Chains in Farangel's Delve
quests.summary: Enter Farangel's Delve, defeat Toll-Master Gaspard, and free the captive pilgrims.
intro: Toll-Master Gaspard holds the kidnapped pilgrims in the subterranean galleries of Farangel's Delve.
Storm Farangel's Delve, defeat Gaspard, and unlock the pilgrim cages.
complete: The captives were freed from Farangel's Delve and revealed that Reynard the Red-Cup carried the Abbey Reliquary toward Wind Keep and Bonesnap Ruins.

journal.start: I must enter Farangel's Delve and defeat Toll-Master Gaspard to free the pilgrims.
journal.done: I defeated Toll-Master Gaspard and learned Reynard the Red-Cup is inside Bonesnap Ruins.

quests.title: The Turnpike Ambush
quests.summary: Clear the wagon-swap site at Glenmoor Memorial and meet Castellan Evrard at Wind Keep.
intro: Reynard's outriders use the old stones of Glenmoor Memorial as a lookout to ambush hospice wagons.
Scout Glenmoor Memorial and report to Castellan Evrard at Wind Keep.
complete: Castellan Evrard secured the turnpike around Wind Keep and prepared the assault on Bonesnap Ruins.

journal.start: I must inspect the ambush site at Glenmoor Memorial and meet Castellan Evrard at Wind Keep.
journal.done: Castellan Evrard marshaled his guards for the strike on Bonesnap Ruins.

quests.title: The Red-Cup's Last Toast
quests.summary: Storm Bonesnap Ruins, defeat Reynard the Red-Cup, and return the Reliquary of Mara to Abbot Clement in Shalgora.
intro: Reynard the Red-Cup is holding a profane banquet inside Bonesnap Ruins using the stolen Reliquary of Mara.
Enter Bonesnap Ruins, defeat Reynard, and return the reliquary to Abbot Clement in Shalgora.
complete: Reynard the Red-Cup has been vanquished, the Reliquary of Mara shines once more in Shalgora, and the abbey turnpikes are safe for travellers.

journal.start: I must enter Bonesnap Ruins, defeat Reynard the Red-Cup, and return the reliquary to Abbot Clement in Shalgora.
journal.done: I defeated Reynard the Red-Cup in Bonesnap Ruins and restored the Reliquary of Mara to Shalgora.
